profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Strategic Software Architect with 13+ years engineering mission-critical systems across defense, healthcare, and cloud platforms. Specialized in designing deterministic hardware interfaces (Rust, C++) and modern web applications (React, TypeScript, Spring, Java). Award-winning lead architect for Pratt & Miller's CORE Lab project, delivering real-time control systems and multiplayer simulation frameworks. Expert in cloud-native architecture on AWS using Terraform, Serverless CDK, and ETL workflows. Certified SAFe Agile Product Owner with proven ability to translate complex requirements into scalable RESTful APIs and automated CI/CD pipelines.

positions.title: Lead Software Architect
positions.locationName: Charleston County, South Carolina, United States
positions.description:
Notable Achievement:  Lead architect for Pratt & Miller's CORE Lab initiative — awarded Best Technology Demonstration at GVSETS. Project details:

prattmiller.com/about/news/core-lab-wins-best-technology-demonstration-at-gvsets

1)  Engineered custom M1A1 Abrams tank hand controls using Rust with multi-threaded architecture (Arcs, Mutexes) for state management across application components, publishing data over DDS
2)  Developed deterministic hardware interface over EtherCAT, achieving >1000Hz data transmission cycle for real-time control systems
3)  Collaborated with a 30-year GD fire control engineer to translate motion control physics algorithms into production code for Azimuth and Elevation systems
4)  Architected a multiplayer framework in Unreal Engine 5 (C++), integrating MongoDB for real-time game state synchronization across networked players
5)  Designed Application Manager with dedicated threads for USB input processing, control loop velocity commands, and DDS domain communication
6)  Established model-driven engineering workflow transitioning from SysML to UML to code generation with logical stubs, improving development efficiency
7)  Built MEAN stack web application for real-time biometric data acquisition and visualization from multiple Hexoskin EKG devices
8)  Implemented GitLab multi-project structure and CI/CD pipelines, automating build/test/deployment processes while mentoring the development team
positions.insights: Skills: Embded · AngularJS · Embedded Linux · Angular Material · Angular · EtherCAT · C++ · Fire Control Systems · Gitlab · Agile Methodologies · TypeScript · Linux Kernel · MongoDB · Rust (Programming Language) · Unreal Engine · Communication · React.js

positions.title: Software Development Consultant
positions.locationName: Charleston County, South Carolina, United States
positions.description:
1)  Led cloud migration strategy from legacy Access Database to AWS, architecting serverless data platform using CDK, API Gateway, and S3
2)  Engineered ETL workflows with AWS Glue and PySpark (Pandas, NumPy) for data cleansing and transformation pipelines
3)  Orchestrated end-to-end data lifecycles using Step Functions for automated processing via Athena and DynamoDB
4)  Implemented cloud security using IAM, KMS, CloudWatch, and CloudTrail; conducted Security Impact Analysis for all systems
5)  Developed React/TypeScript front-end with authorization guards, reusable components, and Material/Bulma design systems
6)  Partnered with stakeholders to assess data readiness and document lessons learned from process improvement sessions
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Software Development · REST APIs · Amazon S3 · Computer Science · Back-End Web Development · Communication · Python (Programming Language) · React.js

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Charleston County, South Carolina, United States
positions.description:
1)  Engineered secure RESTful APIs for DES/CHDR and DHA healthcare programs using Java, Spring, JPA, and Hibernate
2)  Maintained critical healthcare data systems, ensuring reliable synchronization and uptime across disparate platforms
3)  Leveraged BIG IP Systems for load balancing, performance testing, and test automation to ensure scalability
4)  Co-authored company-wide SOP for Git best practices, establishing unified version control standards
5)  Orchestrated Jenkins/Git automated build and deployment workflows; integrated Mirth for healthcare interoperability
positions.insights: Skills: NextGen · Multithreading · REST APIs · F5 BigIP · Git · Jenkins · Java · Computer Science · Back-End Web Development · Communication

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
1)  Engineered service layer solutions using Java (Spring, Spring MVC) and C# (Razor, ASP.NET Core), designing RESTful APIs and Swing application integrations
2)  Led front-end modernization by researching and implementing Angular 6 framework across Navy Enterprise systems
3)  Modernized application infrastructure by reverse-engineering complex Maven POM files to optimize build order and dependency management
4)  Managed DevOps pipeline, including source control migration, CI build optimization, and Liquibase implementation for schema management
5)  Served as SCRUM Master, facilitating sprint planning and analyzing Functional Requirements Documents to drive team efficiency
6)  Provided critical support for major government applications (USCM, Navy systems), developing comprehensive system documentation
7)  Ensured project governance by maintaining Software Development Plans and delivering weekly/monthly progress reports
positions.insights: Skills: REST APIs · Computer Science · Back-End Web Development · Communication · React.js
